和 HDL。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"LDL 是低密度脂蛋白，即“坏”胆固醇。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"HDL 胆固醇过多会增加冠状动脉疾病和其他心脏病的风险。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"高 LDL 水平可导致动脉中斑块积聚。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"这种斑块积聚称为动脉粥样硬化。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"随着时间推移，斑块可使动脉变窄或完全堵塞。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"如果流向心脏的血流被阻断，可能导致心脏病发作。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"如果流向大脑的血流被阻断，可能导致卒中。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"胆固醇检测是一种血液检测，测量血液中胆固醇和甘油三酯的量。","citation_id":"HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:medlineplus-cholesterol-levels:000:2843363a035b"},{"text":"脂蛋白检测，也称血脂检测或血脂谱，测量血液中
